Subject: ClearData webinar follow-up: 20-min demo to review Redwood for analytics pipelines

Hi Kara —

Thanks for joining our "Operationalizing LLMs for Analytics" webinar last week. Glad you could make it! I wanted to follow up and offer a short, focused demo that walks through:
- How Redwood optimizes token cost and latency for ETL-style prompt pipelines
- Embedding/reranking examples for search & similarity tasks
- Integration patterns with Snowflake and S3 (we have a small example connector)

I have a few 20-minute slots this week and next. Can you pick one that works for you?
- Wed 3/24: 9:00–9:20am PT or 11:00–11:20am PT
- Thu 3/25: 2:00–2:20pm PT

If none of those work, tell me a couple times that do and I’ll coordinate a calendar invite. I attached the webinar slides for context and a one-click calendar invite for the 20-min demo. Ben (AE) and Tessa (Customer Success) are looped in for technical/contract questions.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
SDR, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.com

Quick note on timing: our analytics team is mostly on ET (EST) and we have a stakeholder who travels on Wed afternoon PT. Would it be possible to do a slot the following week (Mon 3/29 or Tue 3/30) between 11:00am–1:00pm ET? Jordan (copied) will join as well — he manages our infra integrations.

Also, two quick asks so we can make the session productive:
1) Can Ben include a 1-slide sketch of where Redwood would sit in a Snowflake + Airflow pipeline?
2) Do you have any short notes about data residency / log retention so I can pre-share with security?

-Kara

Hi Kara — nice to meet you over email. I can absolutely add a quick diagram showing Redwood slotted into a Snowflake + Airflow flow (1 slide). I’ll also include a short note on retention and logging — high level:
- Customer can choose private deployment or hosted with VPC options; audit logs and request traces are available for enterprise plans.
- Default hosted retention: 30 days for request metadata; longer retention & export available under contract.

For timing: how does Mon 3/29 at 11:30am ET (8:30am PT / 16:30 UTC) look? We can keep it to 20 minutes — demo + 5 minutes for Q&A — and follow up with the diagram and a short security note before the meeting.

If that works I’ll send an updated invite and include a short agenda: 1) 5-min intro + goals, 2) 10-min demo focused on Snowflake integration and cost controls, 3) 5-min next steps.
